This plot is small, only 0.08 hectares, but the soil here in Mtwara is sandy and weak, so it needs manure and a little urea to give us a good harvest. I will plant with seeds I saved from last season because they grow well here, and my family will do all the work since the plot is right near home. We cannot afford pesticides or irrigation, so we will depend on the short and long rains that come.
